intent: Bring homepage-style visible published-work proof to the relevant high-budget buyer pages without making unsupported production claims.

visual_evidence.scope_reason: Live 390x844 review found text-only proof cards on the new service pages and an abstract illustration on the RFP pair.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: Apply the homepage common components across new pages where buyers need real-work proof.
visual_evidence.comparison: Live homepage with visible filming/portfolio path versus live high-budget service and guide routes.

brief.visitor: A South Florida buyer preparing or comparing a video-production project.
brief.promise: See one relevant, published project and its exact documented scope before starting an inquiry.
brief.primary_action: Open the published project or start a scoped inquiry.
brief.friction: Text-only proof gives a high-budget buyer nothing visual to judge at the decision point.

kpi.event: cta_click with cta_id=published_project_proof_<id>, followed by contact intent
kpi.evidence: public/track.js delegates data-cta clicks to the existing cta_click vocabulary, but no proof-card event exists before this release
kpi.decision_rule: retain only if visual verification passes and the path produces attributable inquiry data

concept.idea: A compact project poster and factual scope card directly beside the page's promise.
concept.brand_reason: It adapts the homepage's work-first behavior without cloning its hero or portfolio shelf.
concept.visible_response: The project poster, title, scope note and link render in initial HTML.
concept.direct_path: Portfolio detail or the existing contact action.
concept.alternatives: Do not use stock media, autoplay, speculative equipment visuals, or a generic carousel.

story.opening: Buyer sees offer and real project.
story.action: Open the project if it is relevant.

content.visible: Approved project poster, title, existing factual scope note and link.
content.optional_html: No content is hidden or client-mounted.

references.borrow: Esteban homepage work-first decision pattern and existing approved portfolio posters.
references.avoid: Duplicating the homepage carousel, extra chrome, or unsupported proof.

components.reuse: Existing portfolio poster source, getPortfolioItemById, getPoster, and shared service/guide renderers.
components.local_reason: PublishedProjectProof is a brand-local server component shared by both renderers; only live portfolio items with local posters resolve.

verification.rendered_states: 390x664, 390x844 and 1440x900 on the target service and guide routes.
verification.motion: No required motion; reduced-motion remains equivalent.
verification.accessibility_performance: Accessible link and meaningful alt text; lazy image below page title.
verification.raw_html: Poster source, scope note, data-cta and destination link appear in generated HTML.
verification.conversion_boundary: Existing contact CTA stays intact and resolves normally; clicking the card emits the existing delegated cta_click event.

learning.metric: published-project proof click followed by inquiry
learning.hypothesis: Putting real published work at the decision point reduces buyer uncertainty.
learning.decision_rule: retain only if the visual experience passes and attributable buyer behavior is measurable
learning.registration_condition: record current production event availability before outcome grading
